spans.s: लप् vt. 1P (pres. लपति) 1. To chatter, to speak, to prate; 2. to whisper, कापि कपोलतले मिलिता लपितुं किमपि श्रुतिमूले Git.G.i.With अनु-, to speak again and again, to repeat.With अप-, 1. to conceal, to hide, विलेपनस्याधिकचंद्रभागताविभावनाच्चापललाप पांडुताम् Na.i.51; 2. to deny.With आ-, 1. to speak, to prate, to talk; 2. to converse.With उद्-, to call out in a loud voice.With प्र-, 1. to speak, to say, e.g. वचो वैदेहीति प्रतिपदमुदश्रु प्रलपितम्; 2. to talk at random, to talk wildly, to talk nonsense, to talk incoherently.With वि-, 1. to lament, to weep, to cry, विललाप स बाष्पगद्गदम् R.viii.43, विललाप विकीर्णमूर्धजा K.S.iv.4, बह्वेवं विललाप सः Bt.vi.11; 2. to say, to speak, to utter.With विप्र-, to dispute, to contradict.With सम्-, to converse, कुतश्चित् संलपतो जनसमाजात् D.K.
लपन n. 1. Talking, speaking; 2. the mouth.
